### About this site

This website was created by Xiaoxue Cui. It is hosted using GitHub Pages, and the source code is available on [GitHub](https://github.com/xiaoxcui/xiaoxcui.github.io). 

Relevant coding materials can be referred to in the lecture [Making a Website](https://p8105.com/making_websites.html) and the lecture [Plotly](https://p8105.com/plotly_and_dashboards.html) for course P8105 Data Science.
